posts.title: The Unresolvable Risk | Issue #169
posts.description: Three regulatory bodies extracted the same admission this week: AI companies cannot guarantee their systems will behave as intended. Two model families shipped the same week.

posts.title: The 120-Day Lag | Issue #168
posts.description: Two governance clocks, five deployment stories, and no shared calendar.

posts.title: The Retrofit | Issue #167
posts.description: Governance is always the work that starts the week after the thing already happened.

posts.title: The Obligation Structure | Issue #166
posts.description: Anthropic targets $2T IPO carrying $518B in locked obligations. Google launches its best model by restricting it. Two competitors write the rules for auditing each other.

posts.title: The Blueprint Exit | Issue #165
posts.description: AMD paid $8.2B to claim the silicon layer. OpenAI's safety framework architect resigned. Florida asked a court to freeze model development. Every other layer is being claimed.

posts.title: The Orbital Compute | Issue #164
posts.description: Google confirmed Saturday that its Project Suncatcher prototype, launched October 1 on a SpaceX rideshare, is in orbit and responding.
